newsitem.title: ITALY: No poison in Italy's parliament - official.
newsitem.headline: No poison in Italy's parliament - official.

text.p: Poisonous the debates in Italy's parliament may be but the assembly insisted on Sunday that there was nothing wrong with the food.
An official statement from the Chamber of Deputies (lower house) said the parliament snack bar would reopen on Monday after being shut for two days to be disinfected.

The closure followed the discovery during a routine health inspection that two of the snack bar staff were carriers of the salmonella bacteria. The statement said tests had shown that they could not pass on salmonella, a form of food poisoning.
